Faded: the AI may fill this gap itself Happy to help! Indoor or outdoor? Any dietary needs I should know about? Outdoor if we can. 60 guests are vegetarian, please keep that in mind. Noted: 60 vegetarian guests. Shall I look for venues? Find three venues in Lisbon. Searched the web Searched the web · 10 pages · 1 retry WebSearch("outdoor event venue Lisbon 200 guests") WebSearch("Lisbon garden venue summer party") WebFetch × 10 ⎿ Fetched 10 pages · 15k of extracts Three options: Quinta terrace, LX Factory rooftop, Estrela garden pavilion. The catering offers are in the project folder. Which one fits? Read a file Read catering-offers.pdf · 20 pages Glob("**/*catering*.pdf") Read("offers/catering-offers.pdf", pages: "1-20") ⎿ Read 20 pages · 55k Sabor Verde fits best: it includes a vegetarian menu for 60. Check hotels near the venue for 150 guests from abroad. Searched the web Searched the web · 12 pages WebSearch("hotels near Estrela Lisbon 27 June") WebFetch × 12 ⎿ Fetched 12 pages · 14.5k of extracts Hotel Lumen and Casa do Rio both have 150 rooms free on 27 June. The guest list is in there too. Great, put the full plan together. Ran a command Added up the costs Bash(python3 budget.py) ⎿ Total 42,300 · 350 tokens Full plan: venue 11,800, catering with the vegetarian menu 17,500, hotels 8,000, music 5,000. Total 42,300 euro. That's 12,300 over our budget. Also check the venue contract. Put the plan together again.
